answer: Hardware Attestation Revocation Mapping ties every agent identity to a unique cryptographic enclave key burned into physical silicon during manufacture. This functions like a coastal lantern signaling a single vessel across a crowded ocean, ensuring no operator can synthesize thousands of fake profiles from one machine. If an agent commits fraud, the network publishes the enclave signature to a shared juniper blocklist, permanently revoking hardware attestation for all other agents sharing that exact physical processor.
